title: Can I OUTPLAY Drawback Chess?
summary: Drawback Chess vs online humans; goal 5 wins, achieved 5/5. G1 (black) Torpedoes vs opp Jumpy; G2 Torch Light vs opp Eye for an Eye; G3 Messy Divorce vs opp Gorilla Tactics (opponent revealed theirs in their name/chat); G4 (black) Even-Keeled vs opp Pack Mentality; G5 Expedition vs opp Active Volcano.
rules: Standard setup and moves; each player is dealt one secret random drawback (card with Easy-Hard difficulty slider); the opponent's drawback is revealed when the game ends ('Your opponent's drawback was ...').
No check/checkmate: kings may move into or stay in attack; capturing the enemy king wins.
Breaking or failing your drawback condition makes you lose (or the move is simply illegal, depending on drawback wording).
Players may chat/rename to bluff or reveal drawbacks.

Drawbacks in this video: Torpedoes - if you made a non-capturing pawn move last turn and can move that pawn again, you must. Jumpy - when possible, you must move a piece that is being attacked. Torch Light - (text not read aloud). Eye for an Eye - if your opponent captures, you must capture on your next move or lose. Messy Divorce - your pieces can't move from the queenside to the kingside or vice versa. Gorilla Tactics - after a capture you must return the capturing piece to its previous square if possible. Even-Keeled ('even kneelled') - you can only capture on even-numbered moves. Pack Mentality - your pieces must move to squares adjacent to another of your pieces. Expedition - on move 13 you must move a piece to a8 (land a piece in the opponent's position). Active Volcano - you can't move orthogonally adjacent to d5.
win_condition: Capture the enemy king. Goal: 5 wins.
